digest.component_or_area: pytest temporary directory management and nested session isolation
propositions: Nested pytest sessions without private --basetemp join the user-global numbered temp root and delete unrelated cleanup-eligible directories on session finish

test_engine_dir.py and test_scripts_import_convention.py execute nested pytest children without passing a parent-owned --basetemp, causing those children to allocate and cleanup the shared numbered root

Pytest 9.1.1 TempPathFactory.getbasetemp creates and registers numbered-root cleanup; pytest_sessionfinish only skips cleanup when _basetemp is None, making executing children vulnerable to deleting unowned trees
Parent-owned tmp_path passed to nested pytest via --basetemp isolates each child's temporary lifetime and prevents cleanup of unrelated trees in the shared root
Existing safe nested launchers at _store_isolation.py, test_external_isolation.py, and pytester-managed calls demonstrate the parent-owned basetemp pattern as the correct mitigation
